about.title: How Seen works
about.blurb: A living catalogue you unlock by noticing the world.
about.catalogueBody: Entries span cars & motorcycles, cigarettes (18+), alcohol, coffee & tea, soft drinks, food, snacks, dairy, clothes & sportswear, luxury & watches, beauty, tech, pharmacy, airlines, banks, instruments, toys, trees, flowers, animals, birds, and mushrooms. Covers start greyscale and locked until you confirm a sighting.
about.scan1: Pick one or more categories (or leave “all”).
about.scan2: Take a picture or upload an image.
about.scan3: AI OCR + visual cues propose up to 5 guesses with confidence % that add to 100%.
about.scan4: If the image is unclear, you are asked to aim at the logo or upload a clearer shot.
about.scan5: Confirm → match to catalogue → bingo unlock with colour restored.
about.refreshBody: Every Monday the catalogue runs a scheduled refresh that can add, modify, or rotate items. Locally: npm run refresh. In CI: GitHub Actions workflow weekly-catalog-refresh.yml.
about.metaNote: Curated living catalogue of human-made brands and still-present nature. Refreshed weekly.
contact.title: Contact us
contact.blurb: Questions about Seen, the catalogue, or your account.
contact.banner: We read every message. For catalogue corrections (add / modify / remove), mention the category and item name — weekly refresh incorporates verified updates.
contact.name: Name
contact.thanks: Thanks — for this demo, please email hello@seen-catalogue.example.
terms.title: Terms of use
terms.s1body: Seen is a personal catalogue and identification companion. You photograph or upload images of brands and living things; local AI cues help match them to a curated catalogue; unlocks are stored on your device (and associated with your account when signed in).
terms.s2body: Cigarette and alcohol shelves are for adults (18+) for identification and cultural literacy only. Seen does not sell tobacco or alcohol.
terms.s3body: Photos and field notes you attach stay under your control in browser storage for this demo. Do not upload images you are not allowed to share. Permanent share links expose unlock metadata you choose to publish via that link.
terms.s4body: Email/password accounts on this demo are stored locally in your browser. Keep your password private. Log out to end the persistent session on a shared device.
terms.s5body: The catalogue is curated and refreshed weekly; it is not an exhaustive list of every brand or species ever made. Entries may be added, modified, or rotated.
terms.s6body: Questions: hello@seen-catalogue.example or the Contact page.
